Class CashierView

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
CashierView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
class CashierView extends JPanel
Provides menu selection, drink customization, checkout, and order confirmation.

    • itemPopup

      private boolean itemPopup(CashierView.Line line, Runnable onRemove)
      Shows the customization pop-up. Returns true if the user added/updated the item. When editing an existing line, onRemove is run if the user removes it (null for a new item).
      Parameters:
      line - the drink line being added or edited
      onRemove - the removal callback when editing, or null for a new item
      Returns:
      true if the user adds or updates the item; false on cancellation or removal
